Natural wood, stone, linen, soft practical lighting, leafy landscaping, restrained dark-green accents, calm premium residential photography, realistic proportions and shadows. The two-building relationship must still read at small article-card size. Leave some quiet sky and garden breathing room; no headline space treatment. Absolutely no words, letters, logos, watermarks, screens, dashboards, phone UI, diagrams, arrows, routing lines, network paths, glowing connection effects, floating objects, translucent panels, inset frames, split-screen treatment, charts, progress bars, sci-fi styling, or poster design.
